title: Uka Ch’amakt’ir Jardín de Prosperidad
intro: Walja yänakampi bendicit uraqinxa, mä ayllux ch’amanchawayiwa, Diosan khuyapayasiñapan chimpunak taypin jakasa. Jupanakan sum jakasipxatapaxa, Tatitupan khuyapayasiñap uñachtʼayäna, uka regalox yuspärañataki ukat istʼasirïñatakiw lurasïna. Ukampis bendicionanakap qhan uñachtʼayapkchïnsa, mä mayjtʼäwiw purinïna, ukat kawkhantï walja qamirïpkäna ukat chuymachtʼatäpki uk yuspärapjjañapatak chʼam tukupjjäna.
clues: Pä jardinanakampiw bendicitäpjjayäta, maynejj kupi toqenjja, maynïristi chʼeqa toqenjja, walja achunakampi phoqantatänwa.
Tatitusan churäwipat manqʼañasataki ukat Jupar yuspärapjjañasatakiw mayïna, mä suma oraqe ukat pampachir Tatitu.
Jachʼa jachʼa tukusaw yuspärañ thakit jitheqtjjayäta, qamirïtasat chʼamanïtasat jachʼañchasa.
Tatitusarux saräwinakas taypin juk’amp jayarst’añapatakiw mayipxta, ukhamat jan ch’amäki ukanak jisk’achañ uñacht’ayasa.
Mä yatiyiriw ewjjtʼapjjetäna, ukampis janiw uka yatiyäwir jan istʼapkayätti ukat jan istʼasajj sarasipkakiyätwa.
Jiwasan jach’a represasa, ukax jiwasan suma jakasiñasarux ch’amanchawayi, qhipharux p’akjataw uñjasiwayi, ukat mä jan walt’ayir uma jalsuruw puriyatayna.

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
